name: cac-good-works-site
description: CAC Good Works Assembly website: tests and tooling only (the site itself has no build step).

scripts.test:unit: node test-calendar.js && node --test test-feeds.mjs test-feeds-media.mjs test-media.mjs test-worker.mjs test-member.mjs test-push.mjs test-scripture.mjs test-csp-events.mjs test-listen.mjs test-rsvp.mjs test-give.mjs test-i18n.mjs test-budget.mjs test-security.mjs test-backup.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:rules
scripts.build: python3 build-pages.py && python3 build-seo.py ${SITE_URL:-https://example.org} && python3 build-icons.py
scripts.test:rules:legacy: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-cac-rules "RULES_FILE=firestore.legacy.rules node --test test-rules.mjs"
